description: This file defines a Java interface named 'HealthCheckProvider' which declares methods for registering health check handlers for system readiness and liveness diagnostics in a microservice environment.

classes.name: HealthCheckProvider
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods for registering health check handlers used for readiness and liveness probes.

methods.name: registerReadinessChecks
methods.description: Registers health checks to determine if the component is ready to serve requests.

methods.name: registerLivenessChecks
methods.description: Registers health checks to determine if the component is alive and functioning.
